## What happened

Describe the problem and what you expected.

## Reproduce

Give the smallest steps using disposable data. Include the source commit or release, relevant configuration keys with secrets removed, and browser/OS when relevant.

## Evidence

Include a short redacted error or screenshot. Do not attach credentials, tokens, database dumps, or private forum content. Report security vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md rather than this form.

## Checks

List the checks you ran and their results. State what you could not verify.
